name: Collecting the oil and fixing problems

pages.text: The base has an internal tank of $(item)8000 mB$() that only accepts crude oil. Pull from it with a mechanical pump and pipes on any side. When the tank cannot fit the next stroke, pumping simply pauses until you drain it.
Look at the base with $(item)Engineer's Goggles$(). It shows the tank content and, when something is wrong, $(item)Machine Invalid$(). That means the base found no deposit:

$(li)the column under the base has a gap or a block that is not an $(item)industrial pipe$() (concrete encased pipes are fine),$(li)the column does not end on an oil deposit,$(li)the base is not exactly above the column,$(li)the beam is not assembled yet.

The base rescans its column every few seconds while running, so a fixed column is picked up without rebuilding anything.$(br2)If the beam does not move at all, check the glue, the axis of every part, the head and connector distances, and that the machine input really turns.
Deposits do not run dry in this version, so one good pumpjack keeps a refinery fed for as long as you want.
